User handbook · by role

Who sees what in One Click PT Notes

One Click PT Notes is shared by everyone on a home-health PT team, but the app looks different depending on your role — some people bill, some manage staff, some just document care. This guide walks each role through what they'll actually see, screen by screen.

Signing in

Every role starts the same way — there's no separate portal per role. Sign in with your work email and password; an admin creates your account and puts you in the right role from the start.

  1. Go to the sign-in page and enter your email and password (or use Sign in with a passkey if one's set up for your account).
  2. If your account has two-factor authentication turned on, you'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app.
  3. First time signing in, or after a password reset, you may need to verify your email before the app lets you past the dashboard.
  4. Forgot your password? Use Forgot your password? on this screen to get a reset link by email.

Roles at a glance

Seven roles exist in the system today. Everyone — regardless of role — can view the patient roster, open a patient's chart, schedule a visit, and write and sign a clinical note; the permissions below only control who can edit patient records, delete a note, touch billing, or manage other staff.

RoleEdit patientsDelete notesBillingManage staffAdmin panel

BillerYesYesYesNoNo

Team Member (default)NoNoNoNoNo
Heads up — Office Manager and Corporate Secretary both have permission to view staff accounts, so the sidebar shows them an Admin panel link. Clicking it currently lands on a 403 page — the admin section itself is restricted to the Admin role specifically. If your team wants those roles to actually reach it, that's a one-line fix worth asking for; until then, treat the link as inactive for those two roles.

Admin

Full run of the system: every clinical record, every invoice, and the only role that can actually open the admin panel to manage staff, roles, and permissions.

users.viewusers.manageroles.view roles.managepermissions.viewpermissions.manage patients.managenotes.manageinvoices.manage

Can do

  • Add, edit patients; assign doctor, insurer, HHA, PT Assistant
  • Write, sign and delete any clinical note
  • Create, send and mark invoices paid
  • Manage staff accounts, roles and permissions
  • Read the full audit log

Nothing restricted

  • The Admin role has no gated screens — everything below is reachable.

Office Manager

Runs day-to-day operations: full clinical access, billing, and hiring/managing staff accounts — everything short of the admin panel itself.

patients.managenotes.manage users.viewusers.manageinvoices.manage

Can do

  • Everything on the Patients, Calendar and Billing pages
  • Delete notes
  • See staff accounts and their roles on the dashboard

Can't do

  • Actually open the Admin panel — see the callout below
Sidebar shows a link the role can't use — the Admin panel item appears because this role can view staff, but the panel itself only opens for the Admin role. Clicking it 403s.

Biller

Focused on getting agencies invoiced: the same clinical visibility as Staff, plus the Billing section — no staff management, no admin.

patients.managenotes.manageinvoices.manage

Can do

  • Edit patients, delete notes
  • Build, send and collect on weekly invoices

Can't do

  • See or manage staff accounts
  • Open the admin panel — no link shown at all

PT Assistant

Delivers and documents care in the field, and can also invoice for it. This is also the role the PT Assistant dropdown on a patient's chart picks from.

patients.managenotes.manageinvoices.manage

Can do

  • Edit patients, delete notes, manage invoices
  • Be assigned to patients as their care-team PT Assistant

Can't do

  • See or manage staff accounts, or open the admin panel

Staff

The baseline clinical role — full patient and note documentation, no billing, no admin.

patients.managenotes.manage

Can do

  • Edit patients
  • Delete notes
  • Everything every role can: view the roster, schedule visits, write and sign notes

Can't do

  • Open the Invoices or Admin sections — neither link appears, and the URL 403s if visited directly

Corporate Secretary

Oversight only — can see the patient roster and the staff/role structure, but can't edit clinical records or manage anyone.

users.viewroles.view

Can do

  • View the patient roster and every chart, read-only
  • Schedule a visit and write/sign a note — that's open to everyone, not permission-gated
  • See staff accounts and roles on the dashboard

Can't do

  • Add or edit a patient record — no New patient button
  • Delete a note
  • Touch billing — no Invoices link at all
Same dead link as Office Manager — this role also sees the Admin panel item (it holds users.view), and it also 403s when clicked, since the panel is restricted to the Admin role specifically.

Team Member (default role, internally called user)

What a brand-new self-registered account gets before anyone assigns it a real role — read access to clinical data, and enough to schedule a visit or write a note, nothing else.

No permissions assigned

Can do

  • View the patient roster and every chart, read-only
  • Schedule a visit for a patient
  • Write and sign a clinical note — note authoring isn't permission-gated for any role

Can't do

  • Add or edit a patient record
  • Delete a note
  • See Billing or Admin — neither link appears
Captured directly from the running app, signed in as one seeded account per role — not mockups. Re-check against the app after any permission changes.
